description: Scala object 'YarnContainerInfoHelper' providing utility methods for retrieving and constructing YARN container log URLs, attributes, and container information within Apache Spark's YARN integration.

methods.name: getLogUrlsFromBaseUrl
methods.description: Constructs a map of log file names to their respective URLs based on a base URL.

methods.name: getLogUrls
methods.description: Generates log URLs for a given container and configuration, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves container attributes as a map, including host, port, cluster ID, and log files.

methods.name: convertToString
methods.description: Converts a ContainerId object to its string representation.

methods.name: getContainerId
methods.description: Retrieves the ContainerId from a container object or from Hadoop util if null.

methods.name: getClusterId
methods.description: Fetches the cluster ID from YarnConfiguration, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getYarnHttpScheme
methods.description: Determines the HTTP scheme ('http' or 'https') based on Yarn configuration policy.

methods.name: getNodeManagerHttpAddress
methods.description: Gets the NodeManager HTTP address from container or environment.

methods.name: getNodeManagerHost
methods.description: Extracts the host part of the NodeManager address.

methods.name: getNodeManagerHttpPort
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP port of the NodeManager.

methods.name: getNodeManagerPort
methods.description: Returns the NodeManager port, defaulting to -1 if container info is unavailable.
